items.title: Walmart Is the Dow's Worst Performer, But Not the Index's Biggest Drag
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.6%, or 310 points, in Thursday's early trading.  Walmart was the worst performer in the Dow, but due to the index's weighting structure, it wasn't the biggest drag.  The retail giant stock was down 8.8%, on pace for its largest percent decline since 2022, Dow Jones Market Data showed.
